notes.title: Major Update - Difficulty reworked + Guns skill trees!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm Ignas, the developer of Graveyard Gunslingers! Over the past few months, I've been working hard to bring more content to the game. This update includes the most requested features—along with a few pleasant surprises!

Key Highlights of This Update:
[b]Gun Meta Progression[/b] – Each gun now has unique, upgradable stats. These stats can be upgraded between matches when selecting gun.

[b]Gun-Specific Skill Trees[/b] – Every gun now has its own custom upgrade path within the skill tree, adding more replayability.

[b]Crossbow & Hunting Rifle Rework[/b] – These guns have been completely redesigned. Play the game and see for yourself!

[b]Reworked Difficulty System [/b]– Instead of the original three difficulty levels, there are now nine more gradual levels! This change was made because many players found the game too hard at first (which is true for the first few runs). However, some players also wanted a bigger challenge. With this system, I hope to satisfy everyone. It’s not perfect, of course, but it’s a step in the right direction.
New Resource Type: Scrap – Scrap is a new resource used to upgrade gun skills.

[b]Pickups[/b] – The game can sometimes feel unfair, especially when you're facing a horde of enemies alone. That’s why there's now a small chance for enemies to drop a health pickup when you're low on health (restores 1 HP). To balance things out, there's also a damage area pickup—don't pick this up! It will hurt your character, so avoid it at all costs.

[b]Enemy-Player Collision Rework[/b] – You can now push through hordes of enemies when cornered, but they can still hit you. Move fast!

[b]More Map Variety[/b] – While there isn't a brand-new map, I’ve added more map piece variety to make each playthrough feel fresher.

Refreshed Settings Menu! This might reset your key bindings after updating. Keep an eye out!

I know you all want even more content, but I'm still just one developer doing my best! The game is far from perfect, and there are many areas I’d like to improve. As long as you keep playing, I'll keep updating.

Cheers, and have fun! 🎉

notes.title: GRAVEYARD GUNSLINGERS is out now in FULL RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]We’ve hit our biggest milestone![/h1][/b]
I’m Ignas, the main developer behind Graveyard Gunslingers, and today I want to celebrate the release of [b]Graveyard Gunslingers[/b] with all of you!

Just before the release, we hit [b]12,800[/b] wishlists! Honestly, I never imagined this would happen, and I owe it all to you – the awesome community supporting Graveyard Gunslingers. You’ve made this journey beyond anything I could have dreamed!

One thing I’ve always wanted for Graveyard Gunslingers was a fresh twist on the bullet-hell genre. This comes in several ways: a dynamic day-night cycle, resource gathering, and a skill tree accessible right from the start. This setup allows players to unlock abilities based on collected resources and fully customize their playstyle. During the day, players gather resources, while night brings waves of zombies, transforming the game into an intense bullet-hell experience! Each game offers a unique map layout, generated from randomized, handcrafted segments that progressively unlock with collected enemy souls, adding suspense to exploration. With varied zombie types and difficulty levels that reward high-risk play, Graveyard Gunslingerspromises a fresh, strategic experience every time.

[h1][b]Game is out NOW![/b][/h1]
It’s time to talk about the full game! I’m thrilled to announce that Graveyard Gunslingers is fully complete! Every bit of content is in place, and (fingers crossed) free from any major bugs.

The full game release is TODAY! I can’t wait for you to try my Graveyard Gunslingers! Your support has brought Graveyard Gunslingers to life, and I’m so grateful for every bit of it!

Our Discord community started to grow as well, with players jumping in to share tips, plan future content, and get hyped together.


See you in the game,
Ignas

notes.title: 🎃 Graveyard Gunslingers Joins Steam Scream Fest + Game Origin Story! 🎃
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I’m Ignas, the main developer behind Graveyard Gunslingers, and I’m excited that my game is part of the upcoming Steam Scream Fest! As Steam’s spookiest event approaches, I wanted to take a moment to share the story of how Graveyard Gunslingers came to life.

[b]THE ORIGIN[/b]
Exactly two years ago, on a cold October evening, I was decorating my house for Halloween. I remember hanging fake spider webs and carving a scary pumpkin. The crisp air was filled with the autumn smell of leaves and wood smoke, and as I worked, my mind started to wander.

"What game should I make next?" That question had been haunting me, creeping into every quiet moment, like a ghost lurking in the shadows. I was thinking about a horror game or something close to it. Definitely something spooky. Then I remembered my first playthroughs of classic survivor-style shooters, and my mind went deeper into that genre. But how could I put my own spin on it?

I wanted something more than just the usual bullet-hell shooter. There were so many of those out there that mine would have to be different—something with that eerie, suspenseful Halloween vibe. And then it hit me.

A bullet-hell game with a dynamic day-night cycle. By day, players could roam freely through a spooky, randomly generated wilderness, harvesting resources and upgrading skills. A quiet, eerie calm would settle over the game during the daylight hours, allowing players to explore and prepare for the night to come. And when night finally fell? That’s when the zombies would rise, turning it into a bullet-hell nightmare—a full-on zombie massacre with explosions, gunfire, and waves of the undead swarming in.

The more I thought about it, the clearer the vision became. A blend of classic Halloween suspense and explosive action, with a chill daytime atmosphere that would give way to intense, heart-pounding survival each night. By the time I’d put up the last of the decorations, the idea was fully formed, as vivid as the pumpkin face I was carving. 

This idea evolved so much during actual development, but I still remember that chilly October night as the one when Graveyard Gunslingers was truly born. I hope you enjoyed reading about its origin—and maybe it even inspires you to play my game, or try out a few more spooky games this season.

And for anyone as excited as I am, don’t forget: Graveyard Gunslingers releases on November 8th, just a couple of weeks away! So mark your calendars, grab your best gear, and get ready to face the wilderness, where day fades to night and the undead rise.

Cheers, and have a fantastically spooky Halloween! 🎃👻

As the nights grow longer and the zombies rise from their graves, it’s the perfect time for thrills, chills, and some exciting news. Today, we’re beyond excited to announce the release date for Graveyard Gunslingers! 🎮

🗓️ Mark your calendars: November 8th, 2024 is the day when you'll step into a world full of undead mayhem, fast-paced action, and all the bullet-hell you can handle.

But wait—before the full game drops, we've got something special lined up! Graveyard Gunslingers will be showcased in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 🚀 You’ll get the chance to try out the demo before the official release. Its available right now! It’s the perfect opportunity to dive in, get a feel for the action, and prepare for what’s coming. 🧟‍♂️⚔️

And that’s not all! We’ve just rolled out a another content update to the demo, adding new features and surprises for you to discover. So, grab your guns, saddle up, and get ready for the showdown! 💥
